commands:
set -eu

APP=/opt/citibike-dashboard
S3=s3://citi-bike-nyc-pipeline/scripts/dashboard
STAGE=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGE"' EXIT

mkdir -p "$STAGE/pages"

for file in bedrock_sql.py redshift_query.py requirements.txt; do
  aws s3 cp "$S3/$file" "$STAGE/$file" --region us-east-2
done

aws s3 cp "$S3/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" \
  "$STAGE/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" --region us-east-2

python3 -m py_compile \
  "$STAGE/bedrock_sql.py" \
  "$STAGE/redshift_query.py" \
  "$STAGE/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py"

# Locate the existing Streamlit Python environment.
PYTHON=$(systemctl show citibike-dashboard.service \
  -p ExecStart --value)

echo "Service command: $PYTHON"

if [ -x "$APP/.venv/bin/python" ]; then
  VENV_PYTHON="$APP/.venv/bin/python"
elif [ -x "$APP/venv/bin/python" ]; then
  VENV_PYTHON="$APP/venv/bin/python"
elif [ -x "/opt/streamlit-venv/bin/python" ]; then
  VENV_PYTHON="/opt/streamlit-venv/bin/python"
else
  echo "Cannot locate Streamlit virtual environment."
  exit 1
fi

"$VENV_PYTHON" -m pip install "sqlglot>=25,<30"

mkdir -p "$APP/pages"

# Back up the files that will be replaced.
BACKUP="$APP/backup-chatbot-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP/pages"

for file in bedrock_sql.py redshift_query.py requirements.txt; do
  if [ -f "$APP/$file" ]; then
    cp -p "$APP/$file" "$BACKUP/$file"
  fi
done

if [ -f "$APP/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" ]; then
  cp -p "$APP/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" "$BACKUP/pages/"
fi

for file in bedrock_sql.py redshift_query.py requirements.txt; do
  install -m 644 "$STAGE/$file" "$APP/$file"
done

install -m 644 "$STAGE/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py" \
  "$APP/pages/2_AI_SQL_Generator.py"

systemctl restart citibike-dashboard.service
systemctl is-active citibike-dashboard.service

echo "Chatbot deployment complete."
echo "Backup: $BACKUP"
